source.title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks

paraphrase: The paper extends the AInstein PINN architecture to Lorentzian signature and validates it by recovering the maximally extended Schwarzschild geometry, using losses encoding the vacuum Einstein equation, a quadratic Weyl scalar constraint, and SO(3) symmetry.
limitations: Not yet independently reproduced by ScienceBro.
Author-side validation uses the upstream training/evaluation path.

source.title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks

paraphrase: Using a Petrov speciality index, a horizon curvature anchor, and a trapped-surface constraint, the authors report finding potentially novel algebraically general (Petrov type I) Lorentzian Einstein metrics with a genuinely trapped interior.
limitations: Authors themselves qualify the result as 'potentially novel'.
Numerical residuals may not establish a globally valid geometry.
Not yet independently reproduced by ScienceBro.

paraphrase: The blackhole branch of the AInstein repository was pinned at commit 54736e46 and inspected on 2026-08-11: TensorFlow/float64 PINN, configs hps_local_lorentzian/schwarzschild/petrovI_{vacuum,bh}, supervised seed models included, but NO trained candidate checkpoints. LICENSE file (GPL-2.0) conflicts with pyproject license field (MIT).
limitations: License conflict unresolved — no code copying until clarified.
Candidate checkpoints must be re-trained locally or requested from authors.

location.section: Appendix B (Component-Level Metric and Ricci Visualisations)

paraphrase: For a representative Schwarzschild run over 2000 sampled points, the reported invariant residuals are: | |S|-1 |: min 1.66e-8, mean 7.83e-5, max 1.31e-2; |K_pred - K_Schw|: min 4.91e-6, mean 5.05e-3, max 1.12e-1; | |rho|-1/sqrt(12) |: min 8.06e-8, mean 9.39e-5, max 2.33e-3.
limitations: Author-side evaluation; sampling and normalization are upstream's own.
Max residuals are orders of magnitude above the means — spatial failure structure needs independent mapping.
